answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 147608 Country: India Title: Should I pay income tax to Govt knowing that my money will be utilized in many things that are non halal. Question: Should I pay income tax to Govt knowing that my money will be utilized in many things that are non halal. Answer ID: 147608 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 376/388/B=5/1438) The government shall be responsible for spending your tax and you shall not be sinful for it. Further, you pay income tax only owing to legal compulsion, hence Allah shall not question you about it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
